verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no AI assistant built into the LaunchDarkly UI that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP server lets external AI clients such as Cursor or Claude Code manage flags in natural language, which is an external-client integration rather than an in-product assistant. The 'Autopilot' tagline describes automated release and rollback, not a delegable assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
